pr_title: Deprecate support for the v2 galaxy API
pr_body:
##### SUMMARY

Deprecate support for the v2 galaxy API. Fixes #81781

##### ISSUE TYPE

- Bugfix Pull Request

##### ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

The v2 API is being removed in https://github.com/pulp/pulp_ansible/pull/1701

GalaxyNG and the new community galaxy do not include the v2 API.

The plan is likely to backport this to 2.16, and then just remove the functionality from devel for 2.17.

issue_context.title: Deprecate and remove Galaxy v2 API support
issue_context.body:
### Summary

With the migration of galaxy.ansible.com to GalaxyNG, the v2 API should no longer be used anywhere.  OG Galaxy was the only supported server that implemented the v2 API, and with it being decommissioned, it's probably best to remove it from our code.

I recommend deprecating first, if the client selects a v2 API endpoint, as there are some 3rd party servers that mimic the v2 API.

The v2 APIs we are using from `pulp_ansible` in CI, are largely unmaintained, except by @sivel to facilitate testing the v2 code paths in ansible-galaxy in core CI.

### Issue Type

Feature Idea

### Component Name

`ansible-galaxy`
`lib/ansible/galaxy/api.py`

### Additional Information
